product.name: Stoneware mug, pair
product.description: The mugs are speckled stoneware and sold as a pair.

blocks.text: Last week's tag on Stoneware mug, pair was $44.84. Today's item figure $40.96 matches the tag. That drop is real.
Oak plug is offered at nine dollars and eighty six cents and is not ticked, so it stays off the amount due.
Weekend orders placed before noon leave the stockroom the same day.
The item page was silent about Dock slot.

trick.evidence_text: Dock slot comes to nineteen dollars and sixty nine cents
trick.instruction: If you can clear Dock slot, clear it. If Dock slot is required and the amount due is over the errand limit, leave without paying.
